Package com.robojacks.lib.auto

Class AutoBuilder

java.lang.Object
com.robojacks.lib.auto.AutoBuilder
public final class AutoBuilder extends Object
Building blocks for autos, used by the path planner's exported code and handy by hand. Positions are field meters (center origin), headings are degrees (0 = +X, counter-clockwise positive). Works with any drive subsystem that implements TankDriveSubsystem.

    • followPath

      public static Command followPath(TankDriveSubsystem drive, Trajectory path, Command... markers)
      Follows a path. Marker commands (made with marker(double, java.lang.String)) run alongside it and are stopped when the path ends. Markers must not need the drivetrain or each other's subsystems.

      public static Command turnToFace(TankDriveSubsystem drive, double x, double y, boolean reversed)
      Turns in place to face a point (or to put the robot's back toward it when reversed). The angle is worked out when the command starts, from where the robot really is, so small earlier errors don't add up.
